name: Sleeping Bag
description: TSA rules for sleeping bags on planes.

carryOn.reason: Sleeping bags are allowed in carry-on baggage if they fit within the airline's overhead bin size limits. Most compressed sleeping bags fit as carry-on.
conditions: Must fit within airline carry-on size limits when compressed
Bulky bags may need to be checked

checkedBag.reason: Sleeping bags are fully allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring a sleeping bag on a plane?

travelTips: Compress your sleeping bag into its stuff sack for carry-on to save space
Large sleeping bags are best checked in to avoid overhead bin space issues

faq.question: Can I bring a sleeping bag on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, sleeping bags are allowed in carry-on and checked baggage. If compressed it must fit the airline's carry-on size limit.

faq.question: Can a sleeping bag be a carry-on item?
faq.answer: Yes, if compressed into its stuff sack and within airline carry-on size limits. Most airlines allow 22x14x9 inches.
